title: Gradient world traversal
slide_intent: Use movement between connected spaces to make variation feel like part of one navigable world.
strategic_value: The green 4 can anchor a broad range of Channel 4 color combinations without requiring a single background.
demonstration: A 30-second sequence moves the green mark through adjoining gradient rooms in blue, pink, teal, yellow and red.
practical_value: Study how a room edge and a moving logo prepare the viewer for the next color environment.

content_islands.name: Traveller
content_islands.spec: Keep the green 4 visible through most transitions, allowing brief departures at edges.

content_islands.name: Adjoining rooms
content_islands.spec: Move horizontally and vertically between differently colored recessed spaces.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animation combines a repeated green mark with varied spatial gradients.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram frames 4 as a traveller through an interconnected universe of content.
